changelog:
Initial release of the Beckmann × Self-Improving + Proactive Agent combination skill:

- Seamlessly connects the Self-Improving + Proactive Agent with the Beckmann Knowledge Graph for deep-reasoning escalation.
- Defines clear triggers for when to offer Beckmann analysis on complex or paradoxical questions, with user confirmation always required.
- Integrates Beckmann insights into tiered (HOT/WARM/COLD) proactive memory, following standard promotion/demotion rules.
- Ensures full independence: uninstalling this skill leaves both base skills intact.
- Provides detailed step-by-step escalation and memory integration protocols for structured, self-reflective answers on advanced problems.
